{{Quote|Sergeant Fyn. A good man. Single-handedly saved half his platoon when they were pinned down under enemy crossfire.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth" />}}
'''Fyn''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] and [[Non-commissioned officer/Legends|NCO]] who fought in the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle of Kothlis]]. He single-handedly saved some clone trooper when they were in trouble. After the battle, he brought a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] with updated data on the previous battle.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Fyn appeared in the [[2010]] novel, ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'', written by [[Karen Miller]]. In the German translation of the novel, Fyn's name is changed to Flynn.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth" />
